name: Bento Grid
intent: Put a small team's whole day on one screen as a grid of named tiles, where visual size reflects priority and every tile either states a fact or opens the full view behind it.
bestFor: Operational portals and daily overviews for small service businesses
Marketing pages that prove a product with a working dashboard built in code
Summaries that must stay traceable to full tables, boards, and calendars
avoidFor: Long-form narrative or editorial reading where tiles fragment the story
Decorative feature grids whose tiles answer no question
Offers that need a single dramatic image or campaign moment rather than information

compatibility.foundationVariables: Proposed additions, not existing runtime variables.
